en.html:
—Heard the news?

—Haan.

—That red warrior everyone's talking about. Must be him. Moriuji, that bastard, too...

—Wasn't it Silver Star...?

—Arre, GHQ had him rubbed out.

—Whoever did it, kya farak—what difference? Serves them right.

—All that doing as they pleased. The bill had to come sometime...!

—Haan...

—But listen.

—Hm?

—Now what happens?

—............

—What DOES happen now...?

—Who knows...

—My backside's getting all itchy, thinking about it.

—This country... Yamato... What's going to happen to it...?

ja.html:
――聞いたか。

　――ああ。

　――きっと、噂の赤い武者がやったんだぜ。
　　　護氏の野郎も……

　――銀星号じゃねぇのか……？

　――ＧＨＱに消されたのさ。

　――何だっていいや。
　　　ざまぁ見やがれ。

　――さんざん好き勝手したツケが来たんだ……！

　――ああ……。

　――けどよ。

　――ん？

　――これから、どうなるんだ？

　――…………。

　――どうなるんだろうな……。

　――わからねえ……。

　――なんか、ケツがむずむずしてきやがる。

　――この国は……大和は……
　　　どうなっちまうんだ……？
